requirement_text.REQ-124: MOB-2 (docs/mobile/requirements.md) needs GET /tenant-config to return { realm_url, locales, default_locale, branding, environment_kind } WITHOUT a bearer token: the mobile app calls it to discover which realm to authenticate against, so by definition it has no token yet. Verified against lib/ on 2026-08-21, this is two gaps, not one: (a) Letflow.Routers.TenantConfig is a stub whose routes land in REQ-078; and (b) Letflow.Plugs.ApiPipeline mounts it behind Letflow.Plugs.AuthPipeline, so implementing the route is not sufficient -- it would still demand the token the caller cannot have. Resolve (b) explicitly: either an unauthenticated variant mounted ahead of AuthPipeline, or a documented exemption inside it. Pick one and record why in the moduledoc. This is the gate for the entire mobile tier -- without it the app cannot reach a login screen -- which is why it is sequenced first in docs/mobile/build-order.md phase M-0. Security scope: an unauthenticated endpoint returning per-tenant data is a tenant-data path by definition and needs SECURITY-REVIEWER. The response must expose only what bootstrap requires. Check the shape field-by-field against docs/agents/instructions/security-invariants.md -- in particular whether an unauthenticated caller enumerating slugs can learn which tenants exist, and what the answer should be for a slug that does not exist.

task.description: RE-VERIFICATION after Step 2d REVIEWER rework, not a fresh gate on new scope. Your prior PASS (handoffs/WF02-REQ124-20260822/step-02c-security-reviewer.json) was against the pre-rework diff. Since then, REVIEWER (Step 2d) FAILed on code duplication and ELIXIR-DEV hoisted safe_get_tenant_by_slug/1 out of both router modules into a new public function Letflow.Identity.safe_get_tenant_by_slug/2 (lib/letflow/identity.ex). Re-verify: git diff main...HEAD -- lib/letflow/identity.ex lib/letflow/routers/tenant_config.ex lib/letflow/routers/mobile_tenant_config.ex. Focus specifically on whether the hoist preserved every invariant your prior PASS relied on: (1) INV-4 -- Letflow.Identity.safe_get_tenant_by_slug/2 still logs only the caller-supplied slug (plus its new context_label argument, which is a static caller-chosen string like "tenant-config"/"mobile-tenant-config", never user input) and never the exception. (2) The function is now PUBLIC on Letflow.Identity -- confirm it is not reachable from any authenticated/tenant-scoped call path in a way that would leak the exception-swallowing behavior somewhere INV-4 wasn't previously scoped to check; grep for other callers besides the two router modules to confirm none exist yet. (3) Confirm both router modules' response shapes (2-key and 5-key allowlists) and mount placement are untouched by this hoist -- the FAIL was about the rescue wrapper only, not the response-shaping logic.
acceptance_criteria: Confirm INV-4 still holds for the hoisted function's actual body
Confirm no new caller of Letflow.Identity.safe_get_tenant_by_slug/2 exists beyond the two router modules already covered by the prior PASS
Confirm both routers' INV-2 response allowlists (2-key, 5-key) are unchanged by this diff
Confirm mount placement (Letflow.Router, ahead of ApiPipeline/AuthPipeline) is unchanged

result.summary: Re-verified `git diff main...HEAD -- lib/letflow/identity.ex lib/letflow/routers/tenant_config.ex lib/letflow/routers/mobile_tenant_config.ex` against the four acceptance criteria. All hold. INV-1: NOT-APPLICABLE (Letflow.Identity.safe_get_tenant_by_slug/2 reads only the global `tenants` table via get_tenant_by_slug/1, no :prefix, no tenant-scoped schema/migration touched by the hoist). INV-2: PASS -- diffed both routers' response-building code (mobile_config_map/1's hand-built 5-key map, and tenant_config.ex's existing 2-key map) and confirmed neither was touched by this diff; only the safe_get_tenant_by_slug call sites changed. INV-3/INV-5: NOT-APPLICABLE (stages not started). INV-4: PASS -- Letflow.Identity.safe_get_tenant_by_slug/2's rescue clause logs only `context_label` (a static caller-chosen literal -- "tenant-config" / "mobile-tenant-config", confirmed by reading both call sites, not derived from any request input) and the caller-supplied `slug`; the rescued `_exception` is never referenced in the log call or anywhere else in the function body. INV-6: PASS -- this handoff is that proof. INV-7: NOT-APPLICABLE (no raw SQL in the diff). INV-8: PASS -- the hoisted function still returns typed `{:ok, _} | {:error, _}` and the rescue still prevents an unhandled crash from reaching the caller. Reachability check: `grep -rn safe_get_tenant_by_slug lib/` shows exactly two call sites, both in the router modules already covered by the prior PASS (lib/letflow/routers/tenant_config.ex:171, lib/letflow/routers/mobile_tenant_config.ex:170) plus the design doc's stale reference to the old private name (not code) -- no new caller exists, and the function is not reachable from any authenticated/tenant-scoped path. Mount placement: `lib/letflow/router.ex` still forwards `/api/tenant-config` then `/api/mobile/tenant-config` before the `/api/v1` -> Letflow.Plugs.ApiPipeline forward, both ahead of Letflow.Plugs.AuthPipeline -- unchanged by this diff (only lib/letflow/identity.ex, tenant_config.ex, and mobile_tenant_config.ex changed; router.ex has no diff in this rework). The REVIEWER-required hoist preserved every invariant the prior PASS relied on and introduced no new gap.
